summary: An open inference engine for embeddings, reranking and extraction was run on CPU only, with no GPU involved: bge-m3 embeddings, two rerankers and a zero-shot multilingual named-entity model. Its embeddings matched the lab's existing embedding service; the English demo reranker (ms-marco MiniLM) ranked French passages wrongly while the multilingual bge-reranker-v2-m3 ranked them correctly; zero-shot extraction worked with labels given at request time. No GPU measurement and no frozen bench.
title: CPU inference engine pilot: embeddings, reranking and zero-shot extraction
